modernity.evidence: Arched image frame and serif headline feel calm and current, but the overall layout is fairly plain.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Centered wordmark and nav, then headline and button; the large arch image competes for attention.

mobile_usability.evidence: Mobile stacks the arch image above the text with a full-width button; the image takes much of the screen.

readability.evidence: Large serif headline and sans-serif body in muted brown on cream; comfortable text sizes.

imagery_quality.evidence: Arch is a beige gradient with a single leaf drawing; pleasant but no photos of the treatment rooms.

trust_signals.evidence: Gold stars with 4,9 and 210 reviews, opening hours, "Depuis 2015" and an address with phone.

cta_clarity.evidence: Brown uppercase "Prendre rendez-vous" button is clear but lacks contrast against the beige palette.

brand_consistency.evidence: Muted brown and beige palette and the serif wordmark are applied consistently.

summary.en: Calm, coherent spa homepage with visible reviews and a booking button. The CTA is understated and the imagery is a simple illustration.
summary.fr: Page d'accueil de spa apaisante et cohérente, avec des avis visibles et un bouton de rendez-vous. L'appel à l'action reste discret et le visuel se limite à une illustration simple.
